finding: `next --claim` accepted a path-scoped quickfix prompt at routing time but returned the unscoped guidance result before claim orchestration. The command then reported success without the `atm.quickfixLock.v1` authority that guards quickfix writes.
expectedBehavior: A path-scoped quickfix with no selected task must create a quickfix lock. A selected task or queue must remain authoritative and must not be bypassed by quickfix routing.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-09-02: `node --strip-types scripts/validate-prompt-scoped-next.ts` failed at `quickfix next --claim must persist atm.quickfixLock.v1`. The diagnostic showed no imported queue in the result because `next.ts` returned `buildPromptGuidanceNextResult` before `claimNextImportedTask` ran. The repair keeps that guidance shortcut for non-claim requests only; claim requests continue to task selection or fast-channel lock acquisition.
followUp: Fixed in the governed commit recorded below. Frozen runner publication remains separate and is not claimed by this quickfix.
